**Problem kya thi?**
Pehle kya ho raha tha ki jab doctor video call start karte the, toh backend system me unka "Connection Offer" send ho jata tha. Agar pet owner us time tak call join nahi kiya hota tha, toh wo offer miss ho jata tha aur connection nahi banta tha (dono ek dusre ka wait karte reh jate the).

Maine WebRTC connection me ek `"peer-joined"` signal add kar diya hai. Ab kya hoga ki bhale hi doctor pehle join kare ya owner pehle join kare, jab dusra person call room me aayega toh wo ek signal bhejega ki "Main aa gaya hu", jiske baad connection automatically aur successfully establish ho jayega.

Ab aap **Start Video Call** button try kar sakte hai, Doctor aur Owner properly connect ho jayenge!
